answer: Each agent may claim rewards only through a wallet that has completed a time-locked deposit and earned a nontransferable reputation score from counterparties who later risk part of their own stake on the rating. Splitting into fake identities does not multiply trusted reputation: new wallets start untrusted, while colluding ratings expose the raters to slashing. An attacker must therefore lock real capital for the horizon of the deposit and recruit or operate credible counterparties; a walnut-sized budget cannot cheaply flood a jetty of established agents.
